FULL OUTER JOIN concept (MySQL
workaround)

FULL OUTER JOIN preserves matched pairs and unmatched rows from both sides. MySQL has no direct
FULL OUTER JOIN syntax.
Tables JදJක්ම unmatched rows තබනවා. MySQL වල LEFT JOIN සහ right-side unmatched rows UNION
Reconcile two independent imported ID lists.
A.id · B.id · 1 · 2 · 2 · 3 · ↓ match on A.id = B.id (except CROSS) ↓ · Join Result pairs (A.id, B.id) · FULL (1,NULL) (2,2) (NULL,3)
Both unmatched IDs survive, and the matching ID 2 appears once.
Table එJක් columns සහ result rows එකින් එක compare කරෙන්න.

SELECT a.id AS a_id,b.id AS b_id FROM a
LEFT JOIN b ON a.id=b.id
UNION ALL
SELECT a.id,b.id FROM b LEFT JOIN a ON a.id=b.id
WHERE a.id IS NULL;
Expected result: Includes all matched and unmatched rows; assumes a.id is non-null for real rows.

Interview question: Why UNION ALL plus anti-match filter?
Answer: Preserves genuine duplicate pairs without repeating matches.
Practice: Create two tables a and b with IDs 1,2 and 2,3.
